summary: Refined the Bornhuetter Ferguson Details layout with stacked panels, DFM-style dataset pickers, and a polished numeric Origin Length dropdown.
details: The Origin Length control uses a narrow numeric dropdown whose menu opens above the adjacent source panel without clipping.
Source fields now use the labels Latest, Development Pattern, and Prior Vector.
The 70px-tall Prior Vector picker top-aligns its label and 30px pills; tokens open their datasets when clicked and can be removed by dragging outside the box or using the right-click Delete menu.
A trailing neutral plus pill with a blue hover state replaces the three-dot Prior Vector picker button.
